name: Roast Salmon with Quinoa, Carrots, Beets & Cilantro-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium beets
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
½ small bunch cilantro
2 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer both to a small saucepan.
Add water, quinoa, and salt to the saucepan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup water
½ cup quinoa
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the quinoa is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a blender (place remaining cilantro in a medium bowl and set aside).

Peel additional garlic; add to the blender along with water, tahini, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp water
1 ½ tbsp tahini
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
¼ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; coat both sides with oil and season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg salmon fillet
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir the beets, and push to one side. Place salmon on the other side of the baking sheet and return to the oven. Bake until salmon is cooked through and beets are tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate the carrots. Add to the bowl with the remaining cilantro.
When the quinoa is done, add to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the quinoa mixture between plates; top with roasted beets, salmon, and cilantro-tahini sauce. Enjoy!
